header.title: Number of HIV infection and AIDS by sex
tablenote: HIV/AIDS statistics are collected through the HIV/AIDS case-based reporting system based on voluntary and anonymous reporting by doctors, and laboratories.
AIDS is defined as having a definitive laboratory diagnosis of HIV infection together with one or more AIDS-defining illnesses.

HIV infection is defined as having a definitive laboratory diagnosis of infection with the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), based on confirmatory laboratory testing such as HIV-1/HIV-2 antibody differentiation immunoassays, Western blot, or nucleic acid amplification tests, regardless of the presence or absence of symptoms or AIDS-defining illnesses.
